parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it), 1-128 printable ASCII characters. The key is global, not per route. A repeat with the same key, method, path and body replays the first answer with the Idempotency-Replayed header set to "true"; a different request under the same key is a 409 idempotency-key-reused.
